narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer reports a French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward has joined Chelsea on a professional deal. London Evening Standard states Chelsea beat Man Utd to a signing. Football London notes Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice despite an Xabi Alonso promise. CaughtOffside claims a Chelsea player with 23 minutes of playing time this season is urged to leave the club. Daily Mirror reports Simon Jordan claims Chelsea are 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City. Football London reiterates Chelsea are labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City despite 114 guilty verdicts.
narratives.headline: Chelsea transfer activity and disciplinary claims

narratives.body: Soccer News reports Chelsea plans a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Football London notes a Chelsea wonderkid who loves Eden Hazard sent Xabi Alonso an 'awesome' message.
narratives.headline: Chelsea linked with Strasbourg winger and receives player message

narratives.body: London Evening Standard reports Emi Martinez confirms a new Chelsea aim after surgery and his injury timeline is 'revealed'. BeSoccer Livescore states Penders is handed a Chelsea opportunity after Martinez's injury.
narratives.headline: Emi Martinez injury update and Penders opportunity
